g.text: Use Case Diagram
DatabaseAdministrator
InventoryManager
LogisticsPlanner
SystemUser
USBD01 - Create a data dictionary/glossary
USBD02 - Create the relational model (logical level)
USBD03 - Instantiate the relational model using SQL DDL code
USBD04 - Insert provided data into the new database
USBD05 - List all line segments of lines directly connecting two endpoints
USBD06 - List all line segments of a given gauge, including the line they belong to
USBD07 - List all line segments of a given owner, including the line they belong to
USBD08 - List all locomotives of a given type
USBD09 - List all locomotives of a given gauge
USBD10 - List all wagons of a given type
USBD11 - List all wagons of a given gauge
USBD12 - List all wagons of a given type and gauge that belong to a given operator
USBD13 - List all locomotives of a given type and gauge that belong to a given operator
USBD14 - Know the total number of kilometers of electrified rail tracks registered in the system
USBD15 - Know how many lines depart from a given endpoint
USBD16 - Know the minimum length of double-track segments in a given line
USBD17 - Know the average length of the segments in a given line, by track type
USBD18 - Know the number of segments in a given line, by track type
USBD19 - Know the number of segments of a given owner, by track type
USBD20 - Know the number of segments of each gauge size registered in the system
USEI01 - Wagons Unloading (Inventory replenishment)
USEI02 - Order Eligibility & Allocation
USEI03 - Picking Plans
USEI04 - Pick Path Sequencing
USEI05 - Returns & Quarantine
USLP01 - Create the domain model (conceptual level)
USLP02 - Access Cargo Handling functionality at a Railway Terminal via a text-based interface
USLP03 - Calculate estimated travel time between two stations with a direct connection and a selected locomotive
